rule: S_N must not be null
rationale: S_N serves as a one-to-one join key with Cust_Bio_dirty and is a mandatory identifier for account records

rule: S_N must be unique across all records
rationale: As a one-to-one join key, S_N should uniquely identify each record; evidence shows one duplicate value '3' that requires flagging

rule: S_N must exist in Cust_Bio_dirty.S_N
rationale: Referential integrity required for one-to-one relationship with customer biography table

rule: Account_No must not be null
rationale: Account_No is a mandatory business identifier for account records

rule: Account_No must be a 4-digit numeric string
rationale: Account numbers are 4-digit identifiers ranging from 1001-1028; stored as int64 but intended as string with exact 4-character length

rule: Account_No should be unique (flag duplicates for review)
rationale: Account identifiers should typically be unique; evidence shows duplicates for values 1001 and 1010 requiring clarification

rule: Full_Name must not be null
rationale: Full_Name is mandatory personal identification data

rule: Full_Name must be in Title Case (excluding lowercase particles like bin, binte, d/o, s/o)
rationale: Evidence shows 13.3% of records have casing inconsistencies (e.g., 'junrong', 'irfan', 'Lee yixuan', 'Hui Min tan') that deviate from the dominant Title Case convention

check_params.logic: any((w[0].islower() if len(w) > 0 else False) or w.isupper() for w in str(row['Full_Name']).split() if w.lower() not in ('bin','binte','d/o','s/o') and len(w) > 1)

rule: Full_Name must not contain consecutive whitespace characters
rationale: Evidence shows one record with extra internal whitespace ('Ramesh s/o  Govindasamy') requiring standardization

rule: ID must not be null
rationale: ID is a mandatory unique identifier field (Singapore NRIC/FIN format)

rule: ID must follow Singapore NRIC/FIN format: one letter (S/T/F/G), 7 digits, one uppercase letter
rationale: 96.7% of values follow the standard 9-character format (e.g., 'S8403757E'); 3.3% use incompatible 7-character format ('S123456') requiring flagging

rule: JoinDate must not be null
rationale: JoinDate is a mandatory historical timestamp for account creation; evidence shows 3.3% missing values

rule: JoinDate must be parseable as a valid datetime
rationale: Column stored as string but intended as datetime; evidence shows unparseable value '2025-13-01' (invalid month 13)

rule: JoinDate must not be in the future
rationale: JoinDate represents historical account creation date; evidence shows future date '2027-01-15' which is invalid

rule: LastLogin must be parseable as a valid datetime
rationale: Column stored as string but intended as datetime64[ns]; all values should be valid timestamps

rule: JoinDate must be on or before LastLogin
rationale: Business logic: account creation date must precede or equal the last login date; sample shows violations where JoinDate > LastLogin

rule: Subscription_Type must not be null
rationale: Subscription_Type is a mandatory business classification field

rule: Subscription_Type must be one of the allowed tier values
rationale: Categorical field with fixed business domain of 5 subscription tiers

rule: SubscriptionFee must not be null
rationale: SubscriptionFee is mandatory financial data; evidence shows 6.7% missing values requiring flagging

rule: SubscriptionFee must be parseable as a numeric value
rationale: Column stored as string but intended as float64; evidence shows non-numeric value 'free' that cannot be parsed

rule: SubscriptionFee must not contain sentinel values indicating missing or invalid data
rationale: Evidence shows '99999' (100x larger than normal range) and 'free' (text instead of number) used as sentinel codes

rule: SubscriptionFee must be non-negative
rationale: Subscription fees represent monetary amounts that should be non-negative; negative values indicate data errors

rule: If Subscription_Type is 'Free', SubscriptionFee must be 0, null, or the string 'free'
rationale: Business logic: Free subscriptions should not incur charges; violations indicate data inconsistency

rule: Status must not be null
rationale: Status is a mandatory boolean indicator for account state

rule: Status must use the dominant boolean representations True or False
rationale: Column contains mixed boolean formats (True/False, yes/no, 1/0) that need standardization; any value outside this set is invalid

rule: AccountBalance must not be null
rationale: AccountBalance is mandatory financial data representing customer account status

rule: AccountBalance must not contain sentinel values
rationale: Evidence shows 99999.0 used as sentinel-coded value approximately 100x larger than normal range, likely indicating missing data

rule: AccountBalance must not be negative (unless representing valid overdraft)
rationale: Evidence shows -150.5 as sign-anomalous value in an almost-entirely-positive column; requires confirmation if valid overdraft or error

rule: PreferredLanguage must be a valid language option
rationale: Categorical field with 5 observed valid language values; no missing values observed but domain should be enforced

rule: Device must be a valid device type
rationale: Categorical field with 3 observed device categories; domain enforcement ensures data consistency

rule: OS must be a canonical operating system name
rationale: Evidence shows inconsistent casing (Android/android, iOS/IOS, Linux/LINUX, macOs); standardization required to official product names

rule: FeedbackScore must be between 1.0 and 5.0 inclusive
rationale: Feedback scores appear to be on a 5-point scale (consistent with FeedbackScore1 max of 5.0); value 7.3 is an outlier exceeding valid range

rule: FeedbackScore must not contain the sentinel value 7.3
rationale: Value 7.3 appears as statistical outlier exceeding expected upper bound and likely represents sentinel-coded missing/invalid data

rule: FeedbackScore1 must be between 1.0 and 5.0 inclusive
rationale: Feedback scores on standard 5-point scale; values outside this range are invalid

rule: Full_Name must match the corresponding Name in Cust_Bio_dirty (allowing for case differences)
rationale: S_N establishes a one-to-one relationship between tables; the full name should be consistent across both tables accounting for formatting differences (e.g., Title Case vs UPPERCASE)

check_params.semantic_check: Full_Name should match Name from Cust_Bio_dirty when compared case-insensitively, accounting for standardization differences

rule: ID must exactly match ID_No in Cust_Bio_dirty
rationale: S_N join key implies ID should be consistent with ID_No in the biography table; exact match required for referential integrity

check_params.semantic_check: ID must exactly match ID_No from Cust_Bio_dirty

rule: Account_No must match Account_No in Cust_Bio_dirty
rationale: S_N join key implies Account_No should be consistent between account info and customer biography tables

check_params.semantic_check: Account_No must match Account_No from Cust_Bio_dirty (after type conversion to ensure comparability)

rule: Name particles (Bin/Binte/s/o/d/o) must be consistent with Gender from Cust_Bio_dirty
rationale: Malay and Indian naming conventions use specific particles to indicate gender: 'Bin' or 's/o' indicates Male, 'Binte' or 'd/o' indicates Female; inconsistencies between name particles and Gender field indicate data errors

check_params.semantic_check: If Full_Name contains 'Bin' or 's/o' (Male indicators), Gender should be Male; if contains 'Binte' or 'd/o' (Female indicators), Gender should be Female (case-insensitive matching for particles)
